responsibility: Builds synthetic MIR shim bodies for compiler-generated operations such as call adapters, vtable and function-pointer shims, clone and drop shims, thread-local shims, function-pointer address shims, and coroutine-construction shims. It constructs these MIR bodies directly, registers the `mir_shims` query provider, and runs the small set of cleanup and normalization passes needed to make shim MIR ready for later stages.
